title: WebDAV Server
descript: WebDAV Server shares one folder on your NAS with Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile WebDAV clients. It offers read-write access over HTTP Basic authentication with a single account (user tos) and a random password kept in the data folder, and supports the standard WebDAV methods PROPFIND, PUT, GET, MKCOL, COPY, MOVE and DELETE. The container runs as uid 1000 on port 8112. There is no web admin UI and no built-in TLS. Files stay in /Volume1/DockerAppData/webdavdocker/media.
release_note: 1.76.0-1: remediated the listing review. C3: added PRIVACY.md and linked it from Help. C9: rewrote every language description to match the delivered service (single account, HTTP only, no web UI). T1: upstream ugeek/webdav has not been updated since 2022 and is built on end-of-life Debian 10, so the runtime was replaced with rclone 1.76.0, the current multi-arch release, and the old image is no longer used. Added the aarch64 package. Port 8112 and the data folder are unchanged.
important: Open http://<NAS-IP>:8112/ and sign in as user 'tos' with the password stored in /Volume1/DockerAppData/webdavdocker/media/.webdav-password. That folder is the shared WebDAV root and files survive restarts and updates. Runs as uid 1000. Plain HTTP only, with no TLS in this package, so use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet. No outbound connections at runtime. Needs DockerEngine. Privacy policy: see Help.

zh-cn.descript: WebDAV Server 把 NAS 上的一个目录变成 WebDAV 共享，Windows、macOS、Linux 和手机客户端都能读写。使用 HTTP Basic 认证，只有一个账号 tos，密码随机生成并保存在数据目录；支持 PROPFIND、PUT、GET、MKCOL、COPY、MOVE、DELETE 等标准方法。容器以 uid 1000 运行，端口 8112，没有网页管理界面，也不内置 TLS。文件保存在 /Volume1/DockerAppData/webdavdocker/media。
zh-cn.important: 打开 http://<NAS-IP>:8112/，用户名 tos，密码见 /Volume1/DockerAppData/webdavdocker/media/.webdav-password。该目录就是 WebDAV 共享根目录，重启和升级不会丢失文件。容器以 uid 1000 运行。本包只提供 HTTP，不内置 TLS；暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。运行时不主动外呼。需要 DockerEngine。隐私政策见帮助链接。
